display_name: WiSig R17 与实增益双先验的源域无标签筛查
description: 首轮 WiSig RX1 筛查未超过 R17 后，固定 R17 和独立 WiSig 实增益先验，学习物理伴随及实增益差异两条逐频实增益，使用独立 RX3 源验证筛查。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off; independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 256 complex points, 8 x 32 groups; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head for evaluation only
data.physical_ids_ref: all 360 source V physical IDs where RX=3; disjoint from first screen RX=1
data.label_map_ref: Original six classes; no L/U TX label used in training, source V label only after independent freeze
data.train_ratio: 7/63/30; use 52604 U after existing calibration exclusion
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing registered source cache and validated source roles
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban

permissions.claim_scope: Only source U_s IQ and simulated paired disturbances. Frozen R17/realgain IQ models; no F weights or outputs in fit, no TX labels or V/target. Source V labels only in independent scorer after all two-view predictions fixed.

checkpoint.initialization: New two-direction frequency real-gain head zero initialized; frozen WiSig R17, and independently trained same-contract WiSig realgain.

sources.role: WiSig source-only realgain and prior physical-gain candidate as frozen controls; source V RX1 already exposed
Full unroll_unshared R17 E20/4940; source-only TX-free F-free training
WiSig source U-trained PacketUNet parent of realgain

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source roles, existing validation_full IDs, strict source-only frozen checkpoint proofs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No LoRa checkpoints used. WiSig source U-only parents and fixed source-selected R17 have compatible original contract; prior RX1 screen used for development.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 2000 updates. On RX3 low-urban require fusion net >=2 in each deterministic half against all four available controls, clean net >=-2 vs each. Report paired bootstrap. RX3 source V is disjoint from RX1 first screen.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker on first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 7,2,3,6,1,4,0,5; LoRa GPU5 protected.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on mismatched source roles/checkpoints, nonfinite values or absent first-step dual gradients, collision, incomplete predictions or independent scorer failure. Preserve all partial artifacts and other owners.

rows.method: Frozen full R17 plus independent realgain as a second direction and physical residual, zero-initialized two-channel real frequency gains
rows.seed_notes: No support; evaluation seed assigns two sample halves, source V RX3 is all fixed existing IDs.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates x 24 U_s, 48000 unlabeled exposures; inherited model training costs separate

notes: First screen RX1 did not promote; this fixed RX3 source panel has no common physical IDs with it.
R17 and the WiSig realgain control use source-only training and the same original physical source contract. There is no LoRa weight transfer and no recognition supervision.
Frozen classifier runs only after source fitting; source V truth opens after all registered two-view predictions are fixed.
DURA v1 R69 matching remains a formal comparison to complete; current source comparator is original R17 as requested. No final acceptance claim follows this screen.
Source V and historical target results have prior exposure. Parameter count is reported without compression or size constraint.
